snippet.title: GROUND BRANCH | 1.0 Launch Trailer | Available Now on Steam
snippet.description:
After years of development and countless hours of community feedback, GROUND BRANCH V1.0 is available now on Steam. This is the most significant milestone in the game's history, built on the strongest foundation GROUND BRANCH has ever stood on.

V1.0 brings the return of the campaign with Operations and a brand new Prologue, the new Outpost map, smarter and deadlier enemy AI, a new door and breaching system, fully overhauled player movement, moon phase stealth, and new gear, weapons, and quality of life upgrades. Playable solo or in co op.

And this is just the beginning, with new campaign chapters, a multiplayer update, and the Mod Kit still to come.

Play now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/16900/GROUND_BRANCH/
